'''Bubble wort processing plants''' were bubble buildings that housed the secret process that [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] used to change biomatter from plants and animals to [[Bubble wort/Legends|bubble wort]]. [[Bubble spore]] and [[Hydenock]] were prime sources of raw material used to make bubble wort.
